name: Noise floor decoupled 40-50-70
description: Ticket 0035 - system noise floor with the motor coupling DISCONNECTED from the rig shaft, so no bearing signal reaches the sensors. Control experiment for the lubrication-vs-temperature finding: does the noise floor itself rise with temperature? Two conditions at each of 40/50/70 C - motor ON but decoupled (rpm staircase 600-3000) and motor OFF (pure sensor/thermal/environmental floor). Motor-on minus motor-off isolates the motor's own contribution. TEMPERATURES 40/50/70 (changed from 30 on 2026-08-27, Kim's call, on two measurements): (a) with the shaft stationary the oil is not stirred, so the rig overshot SV 30 to 38 C within two minutes and then sat at 36 and would not come down - 30 C is not holdable; (b) Keratech22's own temperature steps are 40/45/50.../100, so 40/50/70 overlay exactly onto three real 13 h steps while 30 C has no counterpart in that data at all. ORDER (Kim): at each temperature the decoupled staircase runs FIRST, then the motor-off baseline immediately after at the same temperature - minimal time between the two conditions being subtracted - and that baseline runs straight into the next motor-off ramp, so motor-off is one continuous block. The 20-25 min settle before each staircase is NOT slack: heating is fast but overshoots ~8 C and decays slowly, and measuring inside that transient would corrupt exactly what the test measures. CONFIRMED 2026-08-27: the tach's reflective mark is on the RIG side of the coupling, so rpm_meas reads 0 for the whole test and there is NO independent speed readback - the drive is the only witness. Kim confirmed by eye that the motor turns. Speed of record is 59.83 x vfd_cmd_hz. Cross-check the motor-on segments against UL/AE energy, which must rise with commanded Hz if the motor really ran. Analysis keys on logged omron_pv_c, never the target. NOTE: SP/CHAN3 is known bad (ticket 0038 - no rotation-correlated signal), so its 'noise floor' here is expected to be unchanged; that is a prediction this test can falsify, not a result.
